mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return distribution in declining FEDFUNDS periods shows no significant positive mean compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 300.0 signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank rate hikes, causing negative equity returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 300.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in GDP growth and housing starts indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative equity returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in GDPC1 and HOUST fails to produce negative returns in more than 70% of cases over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market defined by sub-3.5% unemployment and employment growth above 155,000 persons supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive equity returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS > 155000.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index signals expanding manufacturing output, generating positive equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return distribution shows no significant positive mean when INDPRO rises.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales falling below 690,000 million indicates weakening consumer spending, causing negative equity returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: RSAFS < 690000 fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions that support corporate profit growth, driving positive equity returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return distribution in declining UNRATE periods shows no significant positive mean (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, triggering negative equity returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100.0 fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases.
